basic_info.description: Welcome to 245 Ewing Terrace, a spacious single-family home tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in San Francisco's north side. This 3-bedroom, 2-bath residence has been extensively renovated to blend period charm with modern convenience. Flooded with natural light from 7 skylights and large bay windows, the home's refinished hardwood floors and thoughtful layout create a warm, inviting atmosphere. The main level features a bright living room, with a gas fireplace, that flows into the formal dining area and remodeled open kitchen with a large island, quartz countertops, abundant storage, and high-end appliances including a Sub-Zero refrigerator. Two generous bedrooms, one with a walk-through closet to the remodeled bath creating a flexible en-suite option. Downstairs, the substantial primary suite offers two walk-in closets and a spa-like bath with marble tile, dual vanity, and a dual-head rain shower. The lower level also includes a laundry room with sink, folding station, and storage. This home also offers a low-maintenance backyard with built-in seating, ideal for relaxing or entertaining. An oversized one-car garage provides additional storage space. Blending elegance, convenience, and comfort, this exceptional home is ready to welcome its next chapter. Welcome home!
